snippet.title: OPUS: Prism Peak - Launch Trailer｜Steam&Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
OPUS: Prism Peak is out today! Available now on Steam: https://utm.to/8xtrde

The Nintendo Switch version will launch regionally at the following times:
🌎 North America: April 16, 9:00 AM PDT
🌍 Europe: April 16, 2:00 PM BST

A new peak for the OPUS series, featuring  talented English voice actors:
Eddy Yeung, Diana Garnet, Brian Jeffords, Connor 'CDawg' Colquhoun, Hannah Grace, chiisa, Peter von Gomm, Eric Kelso, Adrian Howard, Soness Stevens, Maxwell Powers, Chris Nelson, Emily Reams

Alongside a star-studded Japanese voice cast:
Shinichiro Miki, Kana Ichinose, Kenta Miyake, Nobuyuki Hiyama, Sanae Kobayashi, Mitsuru Miyamoto, Saori Onishi, Kaori Goto, Toru Nara

✨ Insert song created by featured artists Sarah Àlainn (The Promised Neverland) × Kevin Penkin (Made in Abyss)

🎁 Get 10% off when you purchase the game at during launch period!

See you at the summit.
